text:
cheng: Heads-up — 6x H100 units received DOA at LHR depot this morning. Depot logged them but flagged serial mismatch on two. Need vendor RMA and replacement routing. Can we expedite replacements by air?
lara (NexaSupply): Sorry to hear that — can you drop serials and photos? We can do air-express but need confirmation on insurance/declared value. Also need the original PO and RMA ref.
alex: Serial list below and photos in our drive: https://drive.redwood/incoming/h100-doa
- SN: H100-4491A
- SN: H100-4492B
- SN: H100-4493C
- SN: H100-4494D
- SN: H100-4495E
- SN: H100-4496F
maya: Depot notes: 2 units show physical impact, 4 appear DOA on POST tests. Customs code HS8471, we can clear under existing import permit but brokerage might apply for air.
lara (NexaSupply): We can offer two options: 1) Local depot repair (7–10 business days) at our cost, or 2) Air-express replacements from our EU pool (ETA 48–72h) — vendor absorbs freight if replacements shipped under warranty, but we need signed waiver for lost-in-transit value. Which does Redwood prefer?
cheng: Need latency — customer-facing infra depends on these. Prefer air-express if vendor covers freight. Question: can we consolidate with another inbound H100 shipment scheduled tomorrow to reduce brokerage?
lara (NexaSupply): Yes, we can consolidate into a single AWB to LHR tomorrow evening. Need confirmation to proceed and a billing contact for the waiver.
sara (Finance): If vendor covers freight, we just need a credit note for the damaged units (30% credit on unit value proposed). Finance will accept vendor credit memos instead of an immediate refund. Who signs the waiver?
alex: I'll sign operational waiver if legal approves. Can vendor provide the exact value and the text for our legal? Also confirm whether customs will need separate commercial invoice for consolidation.
lara (NexaSupply): Draft waiver and proforma below. Waiver states vendor liability limited to declared value of \u20acXX,XXX per unit. Proforma: commercial invoice will list replacements as "warranty parts" with our invoice number. For customs, list HS8471 and original PO.
maya: Practical note: depot requires AWB + pickup slot 24h in advance. If vendor ships tomorrow evening we can clear by weekend but brokerage fee may be charged — estimate ~\u00a3200 per shipment.
cheng: OK proceeding plan: vendor consolidates replacements into one AWB, vendor covers freight, vendor issues credit note for damaged units (30%), finance approves vendor credit in place of cash refund, alex to sign operational waiver after legal review.
ops-bot: Incident INC-3421 created for DOA batch and linked to this thread.
lara (NexaSupply): Thanks. Sending AWB and pickup schedule now. AWBs:
```
AWB: 567-89012345
AWB: 567-89012346
Pickup: LHR outbound 2024-06-05 18:00 UTC
```
alex: Got AWBs. I'll forward waiver text to legal. Please include the proforma and tracking in the next message. :thumbsup:
maya: Tagging customs broker to prep brokerage payment in case it's charged.
lara (NexaSupply): Uploaded proforma and waiver to the shared folder and emailed sara@redwood.com. Proceeding with consolidation and dispatch. Will update on ETA and tracking.
cheng: Appreciated — keeping this thread as single source. Will update if depot reports any further serial mismatches.
